help.title: Litematica Extras – commands:
help.ai: ask the AI (must be enabled in config)
gui.hint: All other settings are commented in config/litematica_extras/config.json5
gui.aiLock: Lock AI world data in MP
ai.disabled: The AI assistant is off. Set 'ai.enabled' to true in config.json5 and /lx reload.
ai.busy: A question is still running – please wait.
ai.rateLimited: Limit reached: at most {n} questions per minute (ai.rateLimitPerMinute).
ai.noKey: No API key for '{provider}'. Put it into config/litematica_extras/secrets.json5 and /lx reload.
ai.question: Question: {q}
ai.tooManyRounds: Too many intermediate steps – please ask more specifically.
ai.internalError: Internal error in the AI part ({error}). See log.
ai.privacyTitle: ⚠ Privacy notice for the AI assistant
ai.privacyText: Your questions and game data (coordinates, inventory, schematics, possibly player names) are sent to an external service ({provider}). Control what is sent under ai.privacy and ai.tools in the config.
ai.privacyServer: Warning: locating players, searching blocks and listing entities count as cheating on many servers and can get you banned – even though everything runs client-side. You are responsible for following server rules.
ai.privacyConfirm: If you agree, type {cmd}. Your question will then be sent.
help.replace: swap blocks in the plan (zurueck = undo, speichern = save as new file)
replace.help2: Or look at a plan block and type /{cmd} <to>.
replace.help3: /{cmd} undo = undo, /{cmd} save = save as new .litematic file
replace.noTarget: You are not looking at a plan block. Give both blocks: /{cmd} <from> <to>
replace.same: From and to block are the same.
replace.none: There is no {from} in the plan.
replace.note: Note: the change lasts while the schematic is loaded. Permanently: /{cmd} save

voice.notInstalled: Speech recognition not installed yet: /lx voice install
voice.tooShort: Too short – hold the key longer.
voice.help1: /lx voice install – downloads voice and speech recognition (once)
voice.help3: /lx voice an | aus | test | stopp | maedchen | junge | nett | frech | derb
